subject: Coord: multi-window demo + recurring rotating slots
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@borealis.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@borealis.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — infra + procurement attendance

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the outreach — we're excited to see Redwood's inference stack. We need a 60–75 minute session that includes:
- high-level product walkthrough for our PMs
- SE deep-dive for our infra engineers (KV cache, batching behavior)
- procurement to review security/commercial constraints

Attendee constraints: a couple of our engineers are in Dublin (CEST), procurement is in Boston (EDT), and our APAC team in Singapore (SGT) wants to join occasionally. Can you propose windows that reasonably cover these timezones? Ideally avoid anything that falls before 8am PDT or after 10pm CET for core folks.

First-available week for us: Sep 1–5 (we can do afternoon CEST / morning PDT / evening SGT overlaps).

Thanks — I'll loop in security if needed after we lock a date.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering, Borealis Health
liam.oconnor@borealis.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@borealis.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — infra + procurement attendance

Hi Liam — great, thanks for the context.

Quick plan: 75-minute session, split 35/25/15 (product/technical/Q&A). To cover US/EU/APAC overlap we can offer three options that rotate which region gets the most convenient local time:

Option A (US-friendly):
- Thu Sep 3, 10:00 PDT / 13:00 EDT / 19:00 CEST / 02:00 SGT (next day)
Option B (EU-friendly):
- Thu Sep 3, 16:00 CEST / 10:00 EDT / 07:00 PDT / 22:00 SGT
Option C (APAC-friendly):
- Fri Sep 4, 09:00 SGT / 02:00 CEST / 20:00 PDT (Thu) / 11:00 EDT

If none of those work we can do a later EU-first slot on Sep 2.

Notes / asks:
- Dylan (SE) will cover batching/latency and needs to know approximate sequence lengths and KV cache usage.
- Monica (sales ops) will send the calendar invite and a brief pre-demo document.
- If procurement needs SOC2 evidence, please flag and we can attach the compliance pack.

I'll hold Option B tentatively — can you confirm which option your core attendees prefer and whether security should join?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@borealis.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 23:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — infra + procurement attendance

Hi all — thanks for the details. Quick technical notes to make the session useful for your engineers:

- Please share expected batch sizes, typical prompt lengths, and whether you expect many short-chat style requests vs. long-document generation.
- If you want to see a KV cache demo, I recommend we provision a short synthetic workload to reproduce your tail latencies.

For scheduling: Option B (EU-friendly) works best for me, but I can also do Option A if we need to prioritize US daytime. Option C (APAC) is doable but will be late for me (night).

Proposed tweak: start with a 15-minute quick sync for core stakeholders (PM + infra lead + procurement) 48 hours before the demo so I can tailor the technical section. Suggested pre-sync times (45 minutes):
- Tue Sep 1, 15:00 CEST / 09:00 EDT / 06:00 PDT / 22:00 SGT (if this is too late for SGT, we can do earlier)

I'll prepare a short runbook and attach it to the calendar invite.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com
From: Procurement Team <procurement@borealis.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@borealis.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 14:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo request — infra + procurement attendance

Hi Hannah — procurement here. A few constraints from our side:
- We prefer demos that do not show live customer data; sanitized examples only.
- We'll need SOC 2 Type II summary and encryption/KMS details ahead of the call.
- Contracting team needs a standard SOW template at least 3 business days before any commercial discussion.

Regarding times: Option B is acceptable for most of procurement (16:00 CEST / 10:00 EDT). If the demo is scheduled on Sep 3 for Option B please include a doc link to SOC2 evidence and a standard SOW template.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Borealis Health

Thanks — locking in Option B for now:
- Calendar: Thu Sep 3, 16:00 CEST / 10:00 EDT / 07:00 PDT / 22:00 SGT (75 minutes)

Planned agenda (high level):
1) Intro + 10m — product fit (Hannah)
2) Architecture & infra deep-dive 35m (Dylan)
3) Ops, quantization and cost controls 20m (Dylan/Monica)
4) Procurement/legal Q&A 10m (open)

Action items before demo:
- Dylan: short runbook + synthetic workload notes (attached to invite).
- Monica: will send official calendar invite and attach demo brief + SOC2 summary and the SOW template.
- Liam: please add security@borealis.ai and your infra lead to the invite.

Attachments added: demo-brief-borealis.pdf; draft-runbook.txt
Calendar invite stub: borealis-demo-20260903.ics

If anything changes we should reschedule to Sep 4 or Sep 2 — please reply with a hard accept or an alternate.

Best,
Hannah

- Liam O'Connor (Platform lead)
- Maya Patel (Infra lead, Dublin)
- Procurement Team (Boston)

Thanks everyone — see you Thu Sep 3 at 16:00 CEST.
